description:
Upfluence is an influencer marketing platform that uses AI to discover, engage, and manage influencer campaigns. It streamlines outreach for e-commerce and B2B brands.

Upfluence is the influencer and affiliate marketing platform for ecommerce and DTC brands, powered by Jaice AI. Find, manage, and pay creators in one place.

AI influencer discovery by audience and niche. Campaign management and workflow tools. Shopify, WooCommerce, and e-commerce integration. Performance metrics and ROI analytics.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

features: AI influencer discovery by audience and niche.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Access Dashboard
howToUse.description: Go to Upfluence and create an account or request a demo. Log in to the dashboard to begin influencer discovery and campaign management.

howToUse.title: Discover Influencers
howToUse.description: Use AI-powered search and filters to find influencers by audience, niche, location, engagement, and platform. Review analytics and audience demographics.

howToUse.title: Create and Manage Campaigns
howToUse.description: Launch new campaigns, define objectives, and select influencers. Use workflow tools to manage outreach, contracts, and collaborations.

howToUse.title: Integrate E-commerce Platforms
howToUse.description: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, or other e-commerce platforms to track sales, generate affiliate links, and automate influencer rewards.

howToUse.title: Monitor Performance & Analyze ROI
howToUse.description: Track campaign metrics, influencer performance, and ROI in real time. Use analytics to optimize future campaigns for better results.
